character.name: Idle
character.prompt:
Create **Geralt of Rivia from The Witcher** as a high-quality **16-bit/modern pixel art RPG character**, designed for a game inspired by the visual quality and presentation of **Sea of Stars**.

Geralt is standing in a heroic three-quarter pose, recognizable by his **long white hair, pale skin, beard, scarred face, and distinctive witcher appearance**. He wears detailed dark leather witcher armor, layered belts, gloves, boots, and a dark cloak. His **two swords** are clearly visible, with one sword resting on his back and the other positioned naturally at his side.

Use **clean, hand-crafted pixel art**, expressive silhouette, carefully placed highlights and shadows, rich but controlled color palette, strong readability at small resolution, detailed sprite shading, subtle dithering, and crisp pixel clusters.

The character should feel like a **premium JRPG playable character sprite**, with exaggerated but believable proportions, dramatic lighting, and a polished fantasy-adventure aesthetic.

**Full body, centered composition, isolated character, neutral transparent/background-free presentation, no text, no UI, no frame, no border.**

Avoid photorealism, 3D rendering, blurry pixels, excessive detail that destroys readability, chibi proportions, pixel noise, modern smooth digital painting, or oversized head.
